Description: A `#[cfg(feature = "...")]` attribute inside TEST code. Almost always the test replicating the conditional shape of a feature-gated PRODUCTION type rather than testing the feature. Seven files under `rs/ll-open/cli-lib/tests/` build a `DaemonContext` struct literal, and each must gate `vec_index` / `embedder` / `embed_queue` / `text_search` itself, because Rust will not let you initialise a field that does not exist. The result is that production's conditional shape is duplicated across every construction site, `integration.rs` is 3,522 lines partly for that reason, and a reader cannot tell feature-under-test from feature-incidentally-present. The fix is a constructor or builder that owns the cfg ONCE — `tests/common/mod.rs` with a `daemon_context(..)` helper — not a cfg per call site. Whole-file gating (`#![cfg(feature = "x")]` as the first line of a `tests/*.rs`, which cargo compiles as its own crate) is the OTHER correct shape and is deliberately NOT flagged: `cdc` uses it for three test files and has zero inline sites. Bead `ley-line-open-2607d2` workstream; sites are grandfathered in `docs/smell-baseline.json` because the fix is a builder refactor across eight files, not a deletion. The gate holds the line so no NEW inline cfg lands while that is outstanding.
Query: SELECT c.source_id, c.node_id, c.start_row, c.start_col, c.end_row, c.end_col, 1 AS metric FROM cfg_feature_test_sites c WHERE 1=1 %s ORDER BY c.source_id, c.start_row
